name: Swordsmachine
description: (Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Swordsmachine is a greater machine that rebuilt itself from scrap, including its own sword. Renowned for fighting hell's denizens, it can build basic tech from scrap and fights with a durable body, shotgun arm, and motorized sword wielded with finesse. It is powered and fueled by blood.
